t: Husky (tool brand) - Wikipedia
s: 6 days ago - Husky is a line of hand tools, pneumatic tools, and tool storage products. Though founded in 1924, it is now best known as the house brand of The Home Depot, where it is exclusively sold. Its hand tools are manufactured for Home Depot by Western Forge, Apex Tool Group, CSPS and Iron Bridge Tools.
